references.text: The prophet Isaiah also uses the image of new wine in new wineskins to illustrate renewal and restoration, which is similar to Jesus' use of the image to show the need to receive his new teaching with a renewed mind.
The book of Psalms mentions wine as bringing joy to the human heart, which can be seen in connection with Jesus' use of wine as a symbol of joy and new life.
Luke repeats Jesus' parable about new wine in old wineskins, emphasizing the importance of this teaching in the Synoptic Gospels.
Mark also includes Jesus' parable about new wine in old wineskins, showing the universal relevance of this teaching among the Synoptic Gospel writers.
